identity_boundary: Camilo Andrés Pantoja is the name and Colombian nationality claimed by an applicant in Bitso's controlled interview; the civil identity remains unverified. The observed Bogotá residential connection supports two expressly competing explanations—a residential proxy or assistance from someone in Colombia—and leaves both hypotheses unresolved. Same-named people remain separate; the observed IP is withheld; facilitator, proxy, nationality, and physical-location possibilities remain hypotheses.
